title: F49 · the_big_fight · Nobody Spoke for Three Days
lines: It began with one sentence at dinner. Nobody remembers who was right.
Everyone is waiting for someone else to go first.
The house is so quiet you can hear the fridge.
Dadi went up to the roof, slowly, for the first time in a year.
They found her sitting beside the water tank, talking to nobody.
I told him: you forgave the man who cost you your wife. And these fools cannot forgive a sentence.
"I told him: you forgave the man who cost you your wife. And these fools cannot forgive a sentence."
Papa laughed first. He could not help it.
Sorry got said six times, in six voices, mostly at once.
"Sorry" got said six times, in six voices, mostly at once.
Somebody has to go first. Let it be you. That is sadhana.
